description.subtitle: Paris Saint-Germain 2026 2027 Nike Home Kids' Jersey - Blue, Red
description.tagline: The passion of PSG for the youngest
description.intro: The Nike PSG 26/27 Stadium children's jersey maintains the iconic design with the central strip that defines Paris Saint-Germain. A garment that combines style, identity and football so that the little ones can live each game like their idols.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Helps keep skin dry and comfortable.
Stadium Design: Inspired by the players' official kit.
Children's comfort: Regular fit ideal for playing and moving freely.
Light fabric: Promotes mobility and comfort.
High breathability: Maintains freshness during use.
Iconic PSG design: Classic central stripe that reflects the club's identity.
